image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Standalone single-storey small PTT fuel station building, detailed front elevation with a glazed shop frontage and an attached flat forecourt canopy carried on two square clad columns, dark blue fascia band with a red lower stripe carrying the PTT wordmark and flame device, recessed downlight panels in the white canopy soffit, plain rendered side and rear walls with a service door, flat roof with a low parapet and roof-mounted air-conditioning condensers Materials: blue and red printed composite fascia panels and white perforated soffit at the front, plate glass, flat painted render on side and rear walls, galvanised roof plant.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow. Apart from the building's own signage described above, there is no other text or lettering anywhere in the frame.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: PTT / OR. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.92 -- not a pass self-score. 4036/16000 triangles, 11/12 draw calls, 7/8 materials, 11/16 unique geometries. Second build: the whole massing re-authored off the rectified plate and the proxy top-down maps -- one slab, an L-shaped canopy, the kiosk under its rear-right.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at 8.00 x 4.60 x 7.00 m (x -4.00 navy board .. +4.00 stripe wrap, z -3.50 rear run .. +3.50 board). ONE 8 x 7 slab at 4.60 with a 1.0 m edge fascia (navy 0.82 + red 0.15, soffit 3.62) and a 0.30 m parapet ring, on two 0.42 m columns at x +-1.85; the kiosk under its rear-right at x -1.0..3.4, z -3.44..0.5, so the front strip and the -X wing are open canopy -- what the rectified front, the pixel scans and the proxy's top-down maps all agree on.
featureReviews.notes: Second build. The first had the canopy hung BELOW a full-width shell with a 1.05 m upstand wall on the roof, none of which the plate shows. Residuals: the plate is projectively inconsistent, so the kiosk's -X wall (authored -1.0) is +-0.4 m; Meshy still reads the whole plate 43% deeper than the kit's shared 7.0 m module, which wins.

featureReviews.evidence: White flame glyph and italic ptt (0.84 m wide, 0.51 m tall) on navy #343852 at world x +1.5, where the rectified front places it (5.55 of 8 m), with composite-panel joints at 1.0 m and rust streaks bleeding from the top edge on the panels the plate shows them on -- one baked 2048 x 1024 atlas; the -X return samples its own joints-and-rust slice. Red stripe under the band on the front and -X, wrapping 0.24 m round the front-right corner; the +X and rear slab edges white.
featureReviews.notes: The flame is a generated droplet mask, a stylised approximation of the trademark rather than the corporate artwork -- the one part of this feature that is an approximation. Navy held at saturation 0.36 for the hole gate rather than lifted to grey.

featureReviews.evidence: Two 0.42 m square white render columns from the ground into the slab body at x +-1.85, z 2.72; profiled metal canopy deck as 212 instanced ribs on a 0.16 m pitch over the whole L, grey membrane over the kiosk, a 0.28 m upstand along the kiosk's front and -X roof edges between them.
featureReviews.notes: The columns are the render, not the framing metal the first build gave them: the rectified front reads them as the same white as the kiosk. Column setback (0.66 m behind the band face) is the proxy's reading scaled to the module; the plate's elevated camera cannot show it.

featureReviews.evidence: Full-height aluminium sliding-door set x -0.75..1.85 (transom 3.10, meeting stiles at 0.90/1.00, pull handle) beside a window x 2.05..3.35 on a 0.65 m riser (transom 2.90, mullion 2.70), at the rectified shell-front positions; the panes carry the rectified shell front as their image at opacity 0.93 over a dark backdrop slab, shadows lifted to luma >= 88.
featureReviews.notes: A flat image on a flat pane has no parallax; the interior reads as a dim shop at the review angle and slides at grazing ones. That is the residual.

featureReviews.evidence: One large louvred unit (1.0 x 0.8 x 0.9) left of centre and two at 0.62 scale at the +X end of the kiosk roof, on one instanced geometry with per-part tones, at the positions the plate and the proxy height map give.
featureReviews.notes: The plate's large unit has a rear fan grille and pipework the render carries only as a pipe stub.

name: PTT Station Building
nameTh: ปั๊มน้ำมัน ปตท.
notes: Built on the shared 8.0 x 4.6 x 7.0 m building module: detailed front elevation, plain rendered side and rear walls, no loose objects outside. The attached forecourt canopy on two columns is kept because it is structural and brand-defining -- without it the building reads as a generic shop. Fuel pumps and every other loose forecourt object are excluded under the no-objects-outside rule.
